mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), a tightening labor market boosts productivity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month increase in INDPRO, indicating strengthening industrial production, signals improved supply chain efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strengthening supply periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $500B, indicating strong retail sales, consumer confidence is boosted, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances with RSAFS above $500B, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 3% and CPIAUCSL growth decelerates (< 2%), a dovish monetary stance with controlled inflation leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A single-month increase in UNRATE above 5% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE above 5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 1.5-year rolling window.
